newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London up in laid back trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London up in laid back trading.

text.p: The Hang Seng London Reference index opened easier but firmed in late trading on Friday, in tandem with the FTSE 100 index and Dow, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was up 37.16 points at 13,168.57 by 1515 GMT, adding some 30 points after 1500 GMT.
"The Hong Kong stocks in London opened easier than the Hong Kong close for no apparent reason, and firmed later on the back of a rising FTSE and Dow," said one trader.
Another trader said: "There is lots of volatility this time of year as most traders are in the pub and the few left behind can overreact on thin volume."
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index rose to close ahead by 284.85 points, or 2.22 percent, at 13,131.41.
